title: The Immortal Game
intro: Both rooks and the queen disappear. The remaining minor pieces coordinate the mate.

notes.43: Qf6+ draws the knight away from e7. The queen is sacrificed to clear the mating square.
notes.45: Be7 is mate. Every escape square is covered by the surviving minor pieces.
